papers.title: A Computational Study on Porosity Evolution in Parts Produced by Selective Laser Melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: SLM Solutions Singapore Pte. Ltd, 25 International Business Park, #02-15/17 German Centre, Singapore, 609916, Singapore

corresponding_authors.name: Jie Tan
corresponding_authors.affiliation: SLM Solutions Singapore Pte. Ltd, 25 International Business Park, #02-15/17 German Centre, Singapore, 609916, Singapore

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文主要研究选区激光熔化过程中孔隙演变的计算建模，未涉及生物医学植入物、应力遮挡或力学性能测试。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a computational study on porosity formation during SLM process with no biomedical context, no implant design, no mechanical testing (static or fatigue), and no link to stress shielding or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 理解SLM过程中孔隙的形成机制
summary_zh.method: 建立计算模型模拟孔隙演变
summary_zh.result: 预测了工艺参数对孔隙率的影响
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，纯计算研究

summary_en.motivation: To understand the mechanisms of porosity formation during selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: A computational model was developed to simulate porosity evolution as a function of process parameters.
summary_en.result: The model predicted porosity levels and trends consistent with qualitative expectations.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation was performed; the study is purely computational.

summary_zh.method: 对AAHKS和CAS成员进行问卷调查。
summary_zh.result: 发现术后预防措施和设备使用存在显著变异。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the variation in postoperative precautions and equipment use after total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A survey was conducted among members of AAHKS and CAS.
summary_en.result: Significant variability in the use of precautions and equipment was observed.

papers.title: Impact of Powder Variability on the Microstructure and Mechanical Behavior of Selective Laser Melted (SLM) Alloy 718
papers.abstract: Nickel Alloy 718 has found wide use in high-temperature aerospace applications (up to 700°C), due to a combination of good mechanical properties, environmental resistance, and workability at moderate cost. These properties have led Alloy 718 to early adoption by selective laser melting (SLM) additive manufacturing. This presentation will share results from a comprehensive industry survey of 718 powder feedstock for SLM. The survey focuses on the impact of variability in powder characteristics on build quality, microstructure, tensile and high cycle fatigue in the as-fabricated and machined surface conditions. The investigation includes sixteen powder lots from eight suppliers that are produced by gas atomization or rotary atomization in argon or nitrogen. This research was previously presented and published at the 9th International Symposium on Superalloy 718 & Derivatives and was funded by NASA Space Launch System Liquid Engine Office with the Human Exploration Operations Mission Directorate.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究航空航天用镍基合金718的粉末变异性，与生物医学植入物、应力遮挡或骨整合方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on aerospace alloy 718 and does not address porous structures, stress shielding, stiffness matching, surface roughness for osseointegration, or any biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究粉末特性差异对SLM制造合金718质量的影响。
summary_zh.method: 对来自8家供应商的16批粉末进行SLM成型并测试显微组织与力学性能。
summary_zh.result: 粉末变异性显著影响构件显微组织和拉伸及高周疲劳性能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸和疲劳实验验证力学性能差异。

summary_en.motivation: The study investigates how variability in powder feedstock characteristics affects the build quality and mechanical performance of SLM-fabricated Alloy 718.
summary_en.method: A comprehensive survey was conducted using sixteen powder lots from eight suppliers, processed via SLM and evaluated for microstructure, tensile properties, and high-cycle fatigue.
summary_en.result: Powder characteristics significantly influence the as-built microstructure and mechanical behavior, including tensile strength and fatigue life.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing (tensile and high-cycle fatigue) was performed to correlate powder properties with performance outcomes.
